1	---
2	author: 
3	id: F_147
4	internalId: bbf61e6e-adfa-46ee-a2f4-040b8152bc4b
5	title: Live update token usage action popup
6	status: ready
7	owner: 
8	affects:
9	agents:
10	  - design/releases/0_3_0/card__bbf61e6e-adfa-46ee-a2f4-040b8152bc4b.json
11	policy:
12	branch: f_147_live_update_token_usage_action_popup
13	after: 528ea430-ce5c-4e61-ac31-70c93daf5eaa
14	---
15	To investigate: i think token count on action popup is only at end of conversation updated. I think we can do better and update it while the agent is still running.
16	
17	## Current state
18	
19	`ActionUsageSummaryOwner` reads `AgentConversation.usage` from live action-run state. `ActionUsageSummary` then shows that cumulative total for selected conversation or action/card scope.
20	
21	Codex App Server emits `thread/tokenUsage/updated` during active turn, but `agent_streaming_adapter.js` only stores latest value in `turnUsage`. `agent_streaming_event_handlers.js` adds that value to conversation after turn completes, then emits status change without updated usage. Renderer therefore receives new usage only with final `agentClosed` conversation when process exits. Claude reports usage in final result for each turn, so Claude cannot update before provider completes turn.
22	
23	## Implementation details
24	
25	- Define **live token usage** as latest normalized provider usage received while action run remains active. Do not estimate usage from streamed text and do not poll.
26	- Forward each Codex `thread/tokenUsage/updated` value through streaming adapter and agent runner. For providers that report usage only at turn completion, forward value then while conversation can still remain open for next user message.
27	- Publish cumulative conversation snapshot: completed previous-turn usage plus latest current-turn usage. Keep current-turn snapshot separate from persisted cumulative total until turn completes, preventing repeated provider notifications from being counted more than once.
28	- Add focused usage update to agent-run event contract and map it through `ActionRun` into `ActionRunUpdate`. In `ActionRunRegistry`, replace live conversation `usage` immutably so `useActionRunSelector` notifies `ActionUsageSummaryOwner` while preserving entries, status, approvals, and other run state.
29	- Reuse existing `ActionUsageSummary` aggregation and conversation/action-card scope behavior. Do not add timer, compatibility flag, provider estimate, or new popup-owned application state.
30	- Ignore absent usage. Existing normalization remains authority for malformed counters. Final persisted conversation and live total must match after same turn completes.
31	
32	## Acceptance criteria
33	
34	- During active Codex turn, each valid `thread/tokenUsage/updated` notification updates popup token total without waiting for turn completion, agent finish, popup reopen, or project reload.
35	- Conversation scope shows completed previous-turn usage plus latest current-turn snapshot. Repeated snapshots for same turn replace current-turn contribution instead of accumulating it again.
36	- Action/card scope includes live conversation update once and keeps totals from other matching conversations.
37	- When provider reports usage only at turn completion, popup updates at that point even if conversation remains open and waits for next user message.
38	- Missing usage leaves displayed total unchanged. No total becomes `NaN`, negative, or fabricated from streamed text.
39	- Final live total equals persisted total after successful turn completion. Cancellation or failure does not persist unconfirmed current-turn usage unless provider supplied it as completed-turn usage.
40	- Focused tests cover provider event forwarding, cumulative snapshot calculation, action-run event mapping, immutable registry update, both popup scopes, repeated snapshots, missing usage, and final-total consistency.

1	/** Returns displayed conversation context occupancy as a whole-number percentage. */
2	export function contextWindowUsedPercent(contextWindowUsage: unknown) {
3	    if (!contextWindowUsage || typeof contextWindowUsage !== 'object' || Array.isArray(contextWindowUsage)) return null
4	    const { capacityTokens, usedTokens } = contextWindowUsage as Record<string, unknown>
5	    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(usedTokens) || (usedTokens as number) < 0) return null
6	    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(capacityTokens) || (capacityTokens as number) <= 0) return null
7	
8	    return Math.min(100, Math.round((usedTokens as number) / (capacityTokens as number) * 100))
9	}

28	function viewportIsAtEnd(viewport: HTMLDivElement) {
29	    return viewport.scrollHeight - viewport.clientHeight - viewport.scrollTop <= CHAT_END_TOLERANCE
30	}
31	
32	function hasAgentActivity(conversation: AgentConversation) {
33	    return conversation.providerSessions.some(({ agent }) => agent === 'codex')
34	        || conversation.entries.some((entry) => entry.kind === 'message' && entry.agent === 'codex')
35	        || conversation.entries.some((entry) => entry.kind === 'event' && !!entry.providerItemId)
36	}
37	
38	function conversationEventIsVisible(entry: AgentConversation['entries'][number]) {
39	    if (entry.kind !== 'event' || entry.type === 'diagnostic') return false
40	    if (entry.type !== 'reasoning' || entry.status !== 'completed') return true
41	
42	    return reasoningDisplay(entry).hasText
43	}
44	
45	function visibleConversationGroups(conversation: AgentConversation | null) {
46	    if (!conversation) return []
47	    const showEvents = hasAgentActivity(conversation)
48	    const visibleEntries = conversation.entries.filter((entry) => entry.kind === 'message'
49	        || (showEvents && conversationEventIsVisible(entry)))
50	
51	    return buildActionConversationRenderGroups(visibleEntries)
52	}

54	/** Ordered user/assistant transcript shown above the popup prompt. */
55	export function ActionConversationChat({ conversation, status }: ActionConversationChatProps) {

68	    if (nextReservationState !== reservationState) setReservationState(nextReservationState)

70	    const contextUsedPercent = contextWindowUsedPercent(conversation?.contextWindowUsage)

73	        stuckToEndRef.current = viewportIsAtEnd(event.currentTarget)

89	    return (

14	Currently using circular progress on action popup for context usage indicator.
15	
16	This moves slow, so at beginning small. Add background to circle. Ex: put disabled full progress in background or similar, simpler dix.
17	
18	## Current state
19	
20	`ActionConversationChat` (`app/src/components/actions/conversation/action_conversation_chat.tsx`) renders context usage as an MUI `CircularProgress` (`variant="determinate"`, `size={16}`, `color="info"`), fed by `contextWindowUsedPercent()` in `conversation_context_window.ts`, which turns `conversation.contextWindowUsage` (`usedTokens` / `capacityTokens`) into a 0–100 whole-number percent, or `null` when the values are missing or invalid. It only renders when a percent is available.
21	
22	`variant="determinate"` draws only the filled arc — no ring is drawn for the untraveled portion. At low percentages (early in a conversation) the arc is a near-invisible sliver, so the indicator reads as "empty"/absent rather than as a small value on a ring.
23	
24	## Implementation details
25	
26	- In `ActionConversationChat`, render a static full-circle track behind the existing determinate `CircularProgress`, stacked in the same position (e.g. `Box` with `position: relative`, track as `variant="determinate"` `value={100}` in a muted/disabled color, arc `CircularProgress` absolutely positioned on top).
27	- Track uses the same `size={16}` as the arc so both circles align exactly.
28	- Track is visual-only: `aria-hidden`, not part of the `Tooltip`/`aria-label="Context usage"` accessible name, and does not participate in `variant="determinate"`'s `value` semantics (always full, never reflects the percent).
29	- Keep existing behavior unchanged: still renders only when `contextWindowUsedPercent()` returns non-`null`; `color="info"` arc, tooltip text `Context usage: {percent}%`, `aria-label="Context usage"` stay on the arc.
30	- No change to `contextWindowUsedPercent()`, data flow, or polling — this is a rendering-only fix.
31	
32	## Acceptance criteria
33	
34	- Context usage indicator shows a full background ring at all times it is visible, regardless of usage percent.
35	- At low usage percentages (including single-digit and near-0%, e.g. 1–5%), the indicator is visibly a ring with a small filled arc, not an empty/invisible control.
36	- At 100% usage, the arc fully covers the track and the indicator reads as a solid filled ring.
37	- Background track uses a visually muted/disabled color, distinct from the filled arc's `info` color, so the filled portion remains legible against it.
38	- Indicator still appears only when `contextWindowUsedPercent()` returns a non-`null` value; behavior for missing/invalid `contextWindowUsage` is unchanged.
39	- Tooltip text (`Context usage: {percent}%`) and `aria-label="Context usage"` remain on the arc only; the background track is not separately announced to assistive technology.
40	- Existing tests in `action_conversation_chat.test.tsx` and `conversation_context_window.node.test.ts` continue to pass; add coverage for the background track's presence.
